name: Silence Marker
author: Navidrome
description: Detects lead/trail silence around a track's audio using host ffmpeg silencedetect and reports skip/lead_silence and skip/trail_silence media markers

noiseDb.title: Noise threshold (dB)
noiseDb.description: ffmpeg silencedetect's noise threshold. Lower (more negative) is stricter.

minSilenceMs.title: Minimum silence duration (ms)
minSilenceMs.description: Silence shorter than this is ignored.

library.reason: To read the track's file path for silence analysis

silencedetect.reason: To run host ffmpeg silencedetect against the track's audio
